claim: `bkm_implies_regularity` is inconsistent. `BKMFinite ω T` always holds (take M to be the integral), so the axiom asserts that every `u : T3 → ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ` satisfies `SmoothSpacetime u`, which includes `ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun t => u x t j)`; taking `u x t j = |t|` derives `False`. `GalerkinLimit.smooth` depends on this axiom.
requested_change: Delete `bkm_implies_regularity`. A Beale-Kato-Majda criterion has to be proved, or taken as an explicit hypothesis about a genuine solution of the Navier-Stokes equations, with a non-trivial `BKMFinite`.
